_comment: The crew monitor. `provider`: `simulated` invents a plausible rhythm and the slot publishes itself as a stub; `bridge` expects a Bluetooth gateway to push real readings through `biomed.report` (a Polar H10 on the standard Heart Rate Service, relayed by the dashboard page over Web Bluetooth). BIOMED_PROVIDER overrides this; the tests run on `simulated`. The band is what a working adult sits in, not an athlete and not someone asleep: wide enough that moving about does not cry wolf, narrow enough that a real problem leaves it. One number, one place, so a reviewer can argue with it.

biomed._straps: For provider "polar": which strap each person wears. Leave an address out and the sidecar scans for anything advertising the standard heart rate service; give one (npm run biomed:scan prints them) when two straps are in the room, which is the case as soon as two people are monitored. The sidecar is scripts/polar-h10-bridge.py and needs `pip install bleak`.
biomed._names: Placeholders. Replace with the people who will actually wear the strap on the filming day: a screen that watches a person should say who.
